description: We are a Bahrain-based team skilled in AI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Data Science, Python, Robotics, and Hardware. Our space-related research experience includes designing experiments, testing prototypes, and analyzing data. For Earth Systems Trend Detective, we aim to turn NASA data into clear environmental insights. We welcome skills in statistics, GIS, web development, and UI/UX. Join us to learn, experiment, and innovate together!
